verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents bulk operations, such as bulk editing, moving, deleting or updating many items at once. The Postman CLI can run whole collections, and the Postman API can manage assets programmatically, but these are a related test-execution feature and a developer building block, not a bulk-operations capability. Agent Mode is described only for individual actions like sending requests or updating tests, with no mention of acting across many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
